questions.question: About how many times do we blink per minute?
What usually happens to your blinking when you look at a screen for a long time?
Which part of the eye mainly determines its color?
Is the pupil really a black part of the eye?
options: No, it is an opening that lets light in
It is part of the retina

questions.question: Which eye color is usually more sensitive to glare?
options: Color has no effect at all

questions.question: Which habit is associated with a lower risk of developing or progressing myopia in childhood?
options: Using a phone with low brightness

questions.question: What does your pupil do when you enter a dark place?
Which of these can contribute to eye strain when looking at a screen?
options: Looking at something up close for a long time

questions.question: If you see perfectly at a distance, does that mean your vision is 100% perfect?
options: Yes, as long as you do not wear glasses

questions.question: BONUS: What percentage of information from our surroundings is often said to come through vision?
options: This is a trick question: no universal percentage has been scientifically established
